summary:
Implementation plan for the complete Angular application development and backend CORS integration for the MediaHub project. This plan covers:
1. Core API analysis for IAM (Auth & Users) and Content Catalog (Assets, Creators, Tags).
2. Backend changes to add CORS support to the Spring Cloud Gateway and Content Catalog service.
3. Creation of an Angular 18 application with Modules, services, guards, and components.
4. Beautiful responsive UI designed with modern CSS containing features for Creators and Admins.
